metadata.method: Keyword sweep across 2,839 UPSC Prelims PYQs with word-boundary matching. Subject filter: Ancient Indian History, Art and Culture (245 candidate pool). Node-label keywords + ~70 manual aliases (e.g., "Hiuen Tsang" → Xuanzang, "kulyavapa"/"dronavapa" → Land Grants, "6th century BC" → Mahajanapadas). Era-2 terms (Harappa/Mohenjo-daro/Rigveda) treated as negative signal. Final triage pass rejected PYQs whose content is not answerable from era-3 nodes (modern/medieval/current-affairs/Vedic); duplicate question+options sets deduplicated.

confidence_legend.high: Specific node-label match; clearly era-3 answerable from current node content
confidence_legend.medium: Era-3 content + partial overlap with era-2 or medieval (multi-era comparative PYQ)
confidence_legend.boundary: Answerable only partially from era-3 content (e.g., one of 4 pair-match options is in era 3)
confidence_legend.low: Only generic concept-keyword hit; era-3 content may or may not yield the answer

metadata.note: Era-level question bank (NOT node-linked). UPSC questions frequently test multiple tied-together concepts, so node-associations are indicative, not exclusive.
